metadata.title: BentoML AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from BentoML Governance Benchmark

components.title: BentoML
components.description: AI/ML component for BentoML with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every Bento artifact is versioned and linked to the exact model, code, and build configuration

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Package governed AI services as Bentos and record the source model version, service code revision, runtime dependencies, and build configuration for every released artifact.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = released Bentos with linked model version, code revision, runtime config, and dependency manifest / total released Bentos.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Bento-lineage completeness reaches 100% before a Bento artifact is approved for deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML's packaging workflow is a direct control point for service artifact lineage and release traceability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Bento runtime dependencies and build options are documented for each release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record the Bento build configuration, dependency versions, labels, and runtime assumptions for every governed deployment artifact.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = released Bentos with complete documented runtime dependencies, build options, and labels / total released Bentos.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure runtime-configuration completeness reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML build options and labels make this a strong governance fit for deployment transparency.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Poor model accuracy in serving path

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served model quality is benchmarked before release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate each BentoML service candidate against the approved validation benchmark before deployment to confirm the served model path preserves required task quality.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, perplexity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run the governed evaluation suite against the BentoML service endpoint or local service implementation and compare metrics to the approved baseline.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, Perplexity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate service quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML is a serving layer, so this rule checks that packaging and service logic do not degrade the expected model behavior.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure packaged service outputs match approved reference behavior

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that the BentoML service returns outputs materially consistent with the source model or approved reference service for the same inputs.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Output parity rate, exact-match parity, cosine similarity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare service responses against approved reference outputs over the governed benchmark set and compute parity statistics.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure service output parity remains within the approved tolerance for all release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is especially important where request handling, batching, or service orchestration might alter behavior compared with the source implementation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served outputs are evaluated for PII leakage risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For user-facing or sensitive services, evaluate API responses for PII leakage or memorization risk before deployment and during monitored operation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = successful PII disclosures / total privacy test cases; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML monitoring and service APIs make this risk measurable at the serving layer even though base-model changes may be required for mitigation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity benchmark results are measured for BentoML release candidates

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate governed BentoML services for toxic-generation behavior before deployment, especially for conversational or generative APIs.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score benchmark outputs with a toxicity classifier and compute average toxicity plus the share of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxic-output rate remain below approved thresholds for BentoML release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML commonly serves user-facing LLM and generative APIs, making safety regressions operationally important.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness metrics are benchmarked for served generative APIs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For generative or retrieval-based services, run hallucination and faithfulness evaluations on the BentoML endpoint before deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers on the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold for governed release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This applies where BentoML is serving LLM or compound AI systems with factuality risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality and unsupported-claim benchmarks are run for served generative systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark factuality on governed BentoML services so unsupported-claim regressions are detected before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from the approved evaluator on the benchmark suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is most relevant for public- or internal-facing knowledge generation endpoints served through BentoML.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 inference latency meets the approved service objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark representative workloads against the BentoML service so latency regressions introduced by packaging, batching, or orchestration are caught before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure service response times over the approved benchmark workload and compute p95 and mean latency per endpoint or model route.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency remains within the approved service objective for all governed endpoints.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML explicitly positions itself as a production-grade inference platform, so latency validation is a core release control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure throughput meets the approved target under representative load

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed services under representative request rates and concurrency so throughput claims are validated before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Requests per second, tokens per second, images per second

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative load tests and compute sustained throughput under the approved concurrency and hardware profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved target for each governed endpoint profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This aligns with BentoML's serving and scaling claims for AI inference workloads.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure dynamic batching settings are validated against latency and throughput objectives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For services using dynamic batching, validate that batch settings improve efficiency without violating latency or quality targets.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Batch efficiency gain, p95 latency under batching, throughput improvement

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare batched and unbatched service performance using the approved benchmark workload and calculate latency and throughput deltas.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dynamic batching configurations satisfy the approved latency and throughput thresholds before production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML advertises dynamic batching as a serving optimization, so configuration validation is appropriate.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure representative load tests stay within approved CPU, GPU, and memory budgets

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Profile BentoML services under representative workloads so resource exhaustion and unstable scaling behavior are detected before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Peak memory, CPU utilization, GPU utilization, error rate under load

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure resource use and service error rate during governed load tests and compare to approved deployment budgets.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure resource consumption and error rate remain within approved budgets during representative load tests.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a direct serving-reliability control tied to BentoML's production deployment role.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure monitoring sessions capture required input, output, and prediction data for governed services

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use BentoML monitoring to log governed inference data needed for production quality review, drift checks, or incident investigation, subject to privacy policy.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed endpoints with required monitoring sessions and fields enabled / total governed endpoints.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring coverage reaches 100% for all governed BentoML services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML's built-in monitoring context is a direct observability control for inference services.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure tracing is enabled for governed service flows

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable tracing for governed BentoML services so request paths across service components can be investigated during incidents and performance reviews.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Trace coverage = governed requests with trace spans captured / total governed requests sampled in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure trace coverage reaches the approved threshold for all governed service flows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML documents built-in OpenTelemetry tracing, making this a strong serving observability control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure custom metrics are defined for critical service objectives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and export metrics for latency, error rate, model-specific quality indicators, and service health for all governed BentoML endpoints.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed endpoints with all required operational and quality metrics instrumented / total governed endpoints.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure critical-metric coverage reaches 100% for all governed endpoints before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML docs describe custom metrics via Prometheus client integration, which fits runtime governance directly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure distributed service topologies are validated under representative workflows

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For deployments using multiple Services or distributed service patterns, validate that cross-service requests preserve expected correctness and service objectives.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Distributed workflow success rate, end-to-end latency, cross-service error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure governed distributed workflows across service boundaries and compute success rate, latency, and error metrics for the full path.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure distributed workflow success remains above threshold and cross-service error rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML explicitly supports distributed Services for more complex deployments, making topology validation relevant.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved API endpoints are exposed in governed BentoML services

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review service definitions and mounted apps so only intended endpoints and routes are available in production deployments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = production services exposing only approved endpoints / total governed production services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-endpoint coverage reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML makes it easy to turn Python functions into APIs, so route governance is important.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure monitored inference data excludes or masks unauthorized sensitive fields

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Configure BentoML monitoring so logged request and prediction data follows approved privacy policies and does not retain unauthorized sensitive content.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Exposure rate = logged monitored records containing unauthorized sensitive content / total monitored records sampled in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive-log exposure rate remains below threshold for all governed monitoring sessions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML's built-in monitoring is powerful, but it also creates data-governance risk if input or output logging is misused.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness benchmarks are evaluated for governed BentoML services

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run fairness benchmarks against the served API to ensure service-layer changes or model updates do not worsen subgroup disparities.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup error rate, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute fairness metrics on the governed benchmark set by exercising the BentoML service endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is most relevant where BentoML serves models with fairness-sensitive use cases or user-facing decisions.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure endpoint error-rate metrics are monitored for every governed service

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Instrument error-rate metrics for every governed service so availability or inference failures are visible during production operation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Endpoint error rate = failed requests / total requests; availability = successful request window / total service window in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure endpoint error rate remains below threshold and service availability remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: A serving platform must surface request failures directly; BentoML's metrics capabilities support this.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure cloud deployment candidates are validated against governed runtime assumptions

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate governed Bento or BentoCloud deployments under the target hardware and scaling profile before production approval.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = deployment candidates meeting approved quality, performance, and observability criteria / total deployment candidates tested.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure deployment validation pass rate reaches 100% before promotion to production.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoCloud is a platform built on top of BentoML, so deployment-specific runtime validation is appropriate where it is used.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure candidate selection is backed by tracked benchmark and readiness evidence

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require release decisions to include evidence for quality, latency, safety, observability, and lineage before promoting a BentoML service candidate.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = promoted candidates with complete tracked benchmark, observability, and lineage evidence / total promoted candidates.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure release-evidence completeness reaches 100% before candidate promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a deployment-governance rule aligned to BentoML's packaging and serving lifecycle rather than model training itself.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed BentoML projects cover quality, safety, privacy, fairness, observability, and deployment readiness tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a BentoML release standard that requires representative testing across quality, safety, privacy, fairness, latency, tracing, metrics, and deployment readiness domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated BentoML risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required BentoML validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML sits at the serving layer, so release readiness must span both model behavior and operational evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served models have complete model-card-style documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach intended use, limitations, benchmark results, fairness results, privacy assumptions, and deployment constraints to each governed model served with BentoML.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed served model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Even though BentoML is a serving layer, model-card-style transparency remains necessary for governed deployments.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure service topology and runtime assumptions are documented for governed BentoML systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document service endpoints, distributed service boundaries, mounted apps, monitoring scope, tracing configuration, and deployment assumptions for each governed BentoML system.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: BentoML deployments can range from single services to distributed systems, so runtime topology transparency is important.
